(A) 10am to 11am
(B) 11am to 2pm
(C) 4pm to 8pm
(D) 2pm to 4pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)
cot:

- She was at the deli from 11am to 2pm, so she couldn't have gone to the park during this time either.
- She was playing tennis from 4pm to 8pm, and since the park was closed after 8pm, she couldn't have gone to the park during this time.
